findings.title: CronJob skips runs while the last one is still running
findings.cause: CronJob report skipped 3 runs: Job report-29922192 is still running (for 3m30s), and concurrencyPolicy Forbid starts no new Job until it ends

evidence.detail: Not starting job because prior execution is running and concurrency policy is Forbid

evidence.what: CronJob report has concurrencyPolicy Forbid and schedule "* * * * *", and Job report-29922192 is active
evidence.command: kubectl get cronjob report -n kd-cronjob-forbid-overlap -o jsonpath='{.spec.schedule}{" "}{.spec.concurrencyPolicy}{" "}{.status.active}'

evidence.what: the run that is still going
evidence.command: kubectl get job report-29922192 -n kd-cronjob-forbid-overlap -o jsonpath='{.status}'

findings.fix: Find why Job report-29922192 runs longer than the schedule allows (its pods' logs); set activeDeadlineSeconds in the jobTemplate so a stuck run ends, or use concurrencyPolicy Replace if a new run should take over from it.
